title: Schedule of Care Levels and Monthly Care Fees — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
Under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement, each resident is billed at one of six care levels. The care level is fixed by the care-point score of a Larkspur nurse's assessment: a score belongs to the level whose point band, from its lowest to its highest score, contains it. The monthly care fee of the level is billed in addition to the apartment rent, in US dollars per calendar month.

| Care level | Lowest care-point score | Highest care-point score | Monthly care fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assisted Living Care Level 1 | 0 | 15 | 725.00 |
| Assisted Living Care Level 2 | 16 | 30 | 1298.00 |
| Assisted Living Care Level 3 | 31 | 45 | 1874.00 |
| Assisted Living Care Level 4 | 46 | 60 | 2463.00 |
| Assisted Living Care Level 5 | 61 | 75 | 3118.00 |
| Assisted Living Care Level 6 | 76 | 100 | 3846.00 |

### Reading the bands

- Both ends of a band belong to it: a score of 15 is Level 1 and a score of 16 is Level 2; a score of 45 is Level 3 and a score of 46 is Level 4.
- The bands run without a gap from 0 to 100 points. The highest score any level accepts is 100, the top of the Assisted Living Care Level 6 band.
- The monthly care fee is a figure per level and per calendar month; it does not depend on the apartment type.

### Illustrations (hypothetical scores)

| Score on the assessment | Level whose band contains it | Monthly care fee of that level |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | Assisted Living Care Level 2 | 1298.00 |
| 31 | Assisted Living Care Level 3 | 1874.00 |
| 60 | Assisted Living Care Level 4 | 2463.00 |
| 76 | Assisted Living Care Level 6 | 3846.00 |
